extraction.notes: AIR reports NAREIT FFO and Pro forma FFO only; no AFFO subtotal, so affo fields are null. Pro forma FFO is treated as core. Starting line and all adjustments are from Supplemental Schedule 1, three-month 2022 column. Subtotals reconcile: 196,722 to 100,422 to 102,819. Shares 156,136 reproduce $0.64 and $0.66 per share. Judgment calls: the 'Income tax adjustments' and 'Amounts allocable to participating securities' lines were mapped to 'other'; 'Incremental cash received from leased properties' was mapped to 'other'; the separation/transformation line was mapped to severance_restructuring, though it also includes consulting and legal costs. Recurring capex for recurring_capex_disclosed is Capital Replacements of 7,823 for the quarter from Supplemental Schedule 9, which is on a consolidated basis not adjusted for noncontrolling interest. The company does not subtract it in its metric.
